title: Projectivity from zero-or-unit determinantal ideals
statement: Let R be a commutative ring and M an R-module. Let n,p be natural numbers, let P be an n-by-p matrix over R, and let π:R^n→M be a surjective R-linear map with kernel equal to the image of multiplication by P. For each natural number d, let D_d(P) be the ideal generated by det(P[rows,cols]), where rows:{0,…,d−1}→{0,…,n−1} and cols:{0,…,d−1}→{0,…,p−1} are injective. The empty determinant is 1, and an empty collection of minors generates zero. Suppose D_d(P) is zero or R for every d. Then M is projective over R.
lean_statement: ∀ {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (n p : ℕ) (P : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin p) R) (π : (Fin n → R) →ₗ[R] M) (_hπ : Function.Surjective π) (_hker : LinearMap.ker π = LinearMap.range P.mulVecLin) (_hminor : ∀ d : ℕ, let J : Ideal R := Ideal.span {x : R | ∃ (rows : Fin d ↪ Fin n) (cols : Fin d ↪ Fin p), x = Matrix.det (P.submatrix rows cols)}; J = ⊥ ∨ J = ⊤), Module.Projective R M
